entries.name: PowerReview
entries.description: Public GitHub skill. Source is a bare URL; Conduit infers the kind. Default 'wrap' strategy places content under ~/projects/my-app/.agents/skills/PowerReview/.

entries.name: internal-runbooks
entries.description: Private GitHub repo pinned to an immutable commit. Uses CONDUIT_GITHUB_TOKEN.

entries.name: azdo-skills
entries.description: Azure DevOps repo with several sub-paths and the default [env, az] auth chain.

entries.name: local-skill-sample
entries.description: House-style skill kept next to this manifest. Source is a bare relative path.

entries.name: agent-bundle
entries.description: Array source: each element becomes its own independent sub-entry sharing these targets.

Name omitted: Conduit derives 'McpLense' from the GitHub repo name. Bare-URL shorthand: the '/skills' tail is harvested as the sub-path; no '/tree/<branch>/' needed because we're happy tracking the default branch.
Aliased shorthand: in-string ' -> Name' overrides both the source-derived default and the missing entry name.
Object wrapper alias: works around an inner concrete source.

entries.name: flat-tools
entries.description: Strategy 'flat' merges the source's files directly into the target (no per-entry wrapping sub-directory). Useful for layered overlays.

entries.name: expand-collection
entries.description: Strategy 'expand' lifts each top-level child directory of the source to its own sub-directory at the target. Files at the source root are ignored.

entries.name: skills-discover
entries.description: Strategy 'skills' walks the source for SKILL.md folders and fans each one out into every detected agent harness under the target (.opencode/skills, .claude/skills, .codex/skills, .agents/skills, plus OpenCode's global .config/opencode/skills when target is ~).

entries.name: skills-claude-only
entries.description: Same skills strategy, restricted to the 'claude' harness with the per-entry harness filter.
